capabilities: Apply keyword and regex rules to add tags to a note
Preview batch tag changes for the vault or a folder before applying
Suggest tags from word frequency in the current note
Write tags to the frontmatter tags property or an inline tag line
Skip excluded folders and duplicate tags
disambiguation: Not an AI or LLM tagger; tags come only from keyword and regex rules you write yourself.
extras: Makes no network calls and needs no account or API key; ships starter rules for machine learning, AI, meeting and project, and can auto-tag the vault on startup without a preview.
motivation: Built for a controlled tag taxonomy, following a workflow requested in an Obsidian Forum discussion about automatic tag generation.
problem: Keeping a consistent tag taxonomy across a vault by hand is slow, and LLM-based taggers need accounts, API keys or network access.
summary: Rule-based tagger that applies local keyword and regex rules to notes, with batch previews and word-frequency tag suggestions.
